column5: Q1058(a) "a prop keeps travelling and firing after its spawning card leaves the board" and Q1076(a) "a prop keeps reading its spawner card for its effect, even once that card has left the board" are the same effect: the prop's function is unaffected by its spawner leaving the board.

Q1002's variants ("class bonuses count per grid, and a grid holding one class only pays an extra step" / "...a class that appears on every grid pays an extra step") restate Q0999's own variants (c) and (b) - counting class bonuses per grid with a bonus for a mono-class grid or an every-grid class - just reworded.

Q0845(a) "reveals every fake card in play, yours and the town's" and Q0848(a) "reveal every fake card on the board, yours and the town's" are the same reveal-all-fakes action; they differ only in delivery (limited-use consumable vs. skill cue) and side payoff (crime penalty vs. bonus points).

Q1053(a) "a prop is not cleared when its line finishes scoring; it continues into the next placement" and Q1059(a) "props still travelling when a placement finishes resolving carry into the next placement with their paths intact" both mean a prop keeps travelling past the end of the current placement instead of being cleared.
